## Motivation

dLLM requests moved from `Scheduler.waiting_queue` into `dllm_manager.waiting_queue` could fall outside `SGLANG_REQ_WAITING_TIMEOUT` coverage before their first forward.

## Modifications

- Include pre-first-forward dLLM manager-held requests in waiting-timeout polling.
- Preserve existing abort handling and rank-consistent cleanup behavior.
- Add a focused regression covering a stale queued dLLM request and an already-denoising request.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A. This does not change model outputs.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A. This is a scheduler timeout correctness fix.

- [x] Formatted with pre-commit
- [x] Added unit test coverage
- [x] Followed SGLang code style
- [ ] Documentation update not needed
- [ ] Accuracy/speed benchmarks not applicable
